shared_elements: vertically oriented body/figure filling the field
paired symmetrical features (limbs/eyes) about a central axis
justification: Both surfaces present a highly schematic anthropomorphic subject arranged vertically and symmetrically about a central axis, but that is about as generic as figurative correspondence gets. A shows a full standing figure (or paired figures) with legs, arms and a small round head holding a bar-like object, whereas B shows only a face-like arrangement of hollows (eye sockets, nose ridge, mouth) with no limbs, posture or attributes in common.
